BioWelders 🔬🔥

We are a creative, skilled, and collaborative team that combines biotechnology, welding, innovation, and problem-solving. We bring together different talents, technical abilities, and fresh ideas to create innovative solutions. Other teams and members are welcome to join us because we believe that teamwork, knowledge sharing, and diverse skills make us stronger and help us achieve greater goals together!
summary:
BioWelders 25-34 is an advanced space biomedical command center and digital twin designed to monitor, evaluate, and protect the holistic health of space crews and terrestrial analog environments.

We developed an interactive web application that integrates a 3D anatomical model featuring a realistic welding flash effect in the heart area, voice-guided clinical triage, acoustic emotional wellbeing analysis with real microphone permissions, and a monitoring laboratory based on seven space support devices featuring both simple and professional display modes. The platform combines an intuitive interface with easy-to-understand health stoplights suitable for all ages, high-contrast automated emergency protocols, and a multi-environment simulation system (ISS, Spacecraft, Rover, and Planetary Base) that normalizes telemetry to prevent risks such as microgravity effects and prolonged fatigue.

During prolonged space missions or extreme environments, autonomous, rapid, and preventive monitoring of physical and psychological health is vital. BioWelders 25-34 ensures agile decision-making, reduces medical uncertainty, and enhances the wellbeing of explorers through automated support and connection with support networks.
details:
BioWelders 25-34 is an interactive space biomedical command platform and digital twin designed to monitor, evaluate, and protect the physical and emotional health of crews in space missions and terrestrial analog environments. It operates through an immersive interface divided into three core modules and a continuous alert system:

  • Interactive 3D Digital Twin: Displays a rotating 3D anatomical model featuring a subtle welding flash at the heart, symbolizing the fusion between aerospace engineering and human biology.
  • Module 1 (Biological Twin): Includes animated didactic video guides for proper medical device usage (sphygmomanometer, glucometer, thermometer), voice-guided dictation of 6 key vital signs, immediate clinical stoplights, historical trend charts, and persistent local database storage.
  • Module 2 (Voice & Wellbeing Analysis): Uses the device's live microphone (or a simulation mode) to analyze vocal timbre and detect fatigue or emotional overload, triggering recovery activities, psychological support, or surprise audiovisual messages from family on Earth.
  • Module 3 (Daily Analysis & Space Equipment): Provides a quick 3-level self-diagnosis (All Good, Fair, Attention Needed), integrates 7 space support devices, and offers global health charts switchable between Simple Mode (intuitive percentages for the general public) and Professional Mode (technical telemetry for experts).
  • Emergency Protocol ("I am in danger"): Activated via continuous voice command or SOS button, switching the interface to high-contrast (black and yellow) with voice-guided triage for critical situations.
  • Universal Accessibility: Requires no prior medical knowledge thanks to step-by-step guides, intuitive visual stoplights, and a simple data mode understandable by users of any age.
  • Autonomy and Speed: Reduces medical uncertainty in environments where communication with Earth experiences delays or blackouts, enabling preventive decisions in seconds.
  • Holistic Health (Physical & Mental): Addresses both physiological metrics and psychological isolation through automated emotional support and gamification (XP and leveling system for completing healthy routines).
  • Multi-Environment Adaptability: Automatically adjusts preventive routines based on the selected scenario: International Space Station (ISS - 0g), Deep Space Transit Ship, Planetary Rover (0.38g), or Lunar/Martian Base.

In space exploration, BioWelders 25-34 aims to prevent physiological deterioration (such as Spaceflight-Associated Neuro-ocular Syndrome - SANS, bone loss, and radiation fatigue) and strengthen astronauts' psychological resilience during long-duration missions to the Moon or Mars. On Earth, the platform is directly scalable as a preventive telemedicine and remote triage tool for isolated communities, polar research stations, rescue personnel, or home-care patients requiring voice-guided assistance.

  • Programming Languages & Web Architecture: HTML5, CSS3, and modern JavaScript (ES6+).
  • 3D Graphics & Data Visualization: Three.js (WebGL) for rendering the holographic 3D anatomical model and space environment; Chart.js for dynamic historical trend and global health charts.
  • Design & UI: Tailwind CSS and Font Awesome for a responsive, HUD-style (Heads-Up Display) space aesthetic and a high-contrast emergency mode.
  • Native Browser APIs & Hardware: Web Speech API (SpeechRecognition and SpeechSynthesis) for guided vital signs dictation, voice assistance, and active listening for emergency commands; MediaDevices API (getUserMedia) for live device microphone access; and LocalStorage API for persistent clinical logs without requiring constant internet connectivity.
  • Conceptual Fusion ("BioWelders"): Visually represents the bond between precision engineering and human life through a digital twin with a luminous welding pulse in the heart.
  • Dual-Layer Comprehension (Simple vs. Pro): Solves the challenge of communicating complex medical data by allowing users to toggle with one click between a public-friendly view and an advanced clinical view.
  • Humanizing Space Technology: Integrates emotional support by unlocking family audiovisual messages ("surprise gifts") whenever voice analysis detects high stress levels in a crew member.
  • Health Gamification: Turns preventive medical routines into missions with experience points (XP) and levels to encourage daily adherence.
  • Physiological & Environmental Factors: The real effects of microgravity (0g), partial gravity (0.16g on the Moon, 0.38g on Mars), and cosmic radiation on the human body.
  • Human & Psychological Factors: The impact of prolonged isolation, cognitive fatigue, and the need for emotional grounding.
  • Usability in Critical Situations (Cognitive Ergonomics): We designed the emergency mode with high-contrast colors (black/yellow), oversized buttons, and audio guidance for users experiencing impaired vision, dizziness, or acute stress.
  • Offline Operation & Privacy: All logic, animations, and medical logs operate self-contained and locally on the device, ensuring immediate availability even without satellite connectivity.
